title: F1+: in durable mode one LEGACY startup failure blocks every new placement in the tenant
subtitle: P4 probe: worker SIGKILLed while its first attest is held, then a second placement in the same tenant starts (LEGACY: workspace-b via a second Broker; MANAGED: harness-2 in the same workspace)

table: ++ READY; slot-1 stays blocked (409 conflict with A)

blocks.label: RuntimeBindingRecord.blocksPlacement at 36f87cd0e6 (from base 0dd60d4503) and candidate C
blocks.pre:
== // A local managed worker without a lease or attested generation never
== // admitted a Session; failed startup still blocks its own slot.
   boolean unreclaimed = state == State.LOST
           || state == State.RECOVERY_BLOCKED
-- -                && (!request.isManagedContext()
-- -                        || !LocalProcessRuntimeProvisioner.KIND.equals(
++ +                && (!LocalProcessRuntimeProvisioner.KIND.equals(
                                request.getProvisionerKind())
                        || lease != null
                        || attestationGeneration > 0)
           || state == State.FAILED && provisionSeed != null;

blocks.note: Before this PR a LEGACY local startup failure never reached RECOVERY_BLOCKED; it was retryable and recovered. In durable mode it does, and the base keeps LEGACY RECOVERY_BLOCKED tenant-wide. The base's own reasoning (no lease, no attestation, so no Session was admitted) applies to LEGACY too. Candidate C only extends it; A+B+C: runtime-broker 403/0/2, server 141/141.
